name: Monsanto Scholarship (M.Sc. Agriculture Science and Agriculture Biotechnology)
benefit: **Rate of Scholarship:** ₹1,000/- per month (For 3 semesters only).
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in an M.Sc. in Agricultural Science or Agricultural Biotechnology program at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar. 1. The scholarship is awarded for a duration of three semesters only.
